items.title: WARN Act and Life Insurance — What Happens to Your Coverage After a Layoff
items.pt:
WARN Act and Life Insurance, What Happens to Your Coverage After a Layoff


When a WARN notice arrives, most workers focus on pay, unemployment benefits, and health insurance. Life insurance is easy to overlook, until it is gone. Many employer-paid policies end when employment ends, sometimes on the last day of work. The notice period is the time to check what you have and when it stops. This article explains the general rules; it is not legal or financial advice, and exact terms depend on you

items.title: Latent Reasoning in Continuous Space for Unified Multimodal Models
items.pt: Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) achieve remarkable success on diverse multimodal understanding and generation tasks, yet they still struggle to effectively leverage language-based chain-of-thought reasoning for image generation. As a result, existing reasoning-augmented UMMs often fail to inherit the test-time scaling and fine-grained controllability observed in large language models. items.title: Latent Sparse Attention: Towards Subquadratic Ultra-Long Context Attention
items.pt: Agentic workflows are increasingly shifting towards long-horizon tasks, such as open-ended scientific work, where models benefit from long context windows. However, at ultra-long context (above 1M tokens), full attention is prohibitively expensive. A promising approach is sparse attention, in which a dedicated indexer selects a subset of keys for the attention.
